ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.7 (TieJin Modify) 个人身体敏感度与通用频率属性、PNA生产启停与储量／营养提示、真实主人方向吸引力、UAP手动多人兼容，以及受方倒地继续调教和共振查询优化。 新增仅RimWorld 1.7；1.6／Common保留SSC 2.4.1冻结基线。敏感度默认关闭，生产开关默认开启；UAP手动许可豁免默认关闭，仍保留匹配与身体条件，读档取消未完成会话。 继承浪漫控制／心情／日志与个人恢复默认、子宫／生育与胃部开发、文化／医美、关系概览、九把PNA武器、凝胶外观、六特化及人格转移。 本版功能已有分批实机认可，PNA产出引导已确认有效；繁英俄浪漫显示与未报告组合继续保留独立验证范围。 升级时完整替换旧目录，保留版本目录与LoadFolders.xml。1.7已移除的旧简易PNA发射器等定义不提供存档迁移。 Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载；文化及仪式需要Ideology。兔入口与旧RimTalk对接仍不可用。
Version 2.4.7 — body sensitivity, personal production controls and compatibility fixes. Adds a general frequency stat, PNA pause/resume with batch/nutrition display, directed attraction toward the actual Master, manual UAP group compatibility, downed-receiver Training continuity and resonance-query deduplication. New features target RimWorld 1.7; 1.6/Common retain frozen SSC 2.4.1 content. Sensitivity and the manual UAP permission override default to off; ordinary PNA production defaults to enabled. Native matching/body requirements remain; unfinished group sessions are canceled on load. Retains romance controls, moods/logs, body development, culture/cosmetics, bonds, nine PNA weapons, gel appearance, specializations and personality transfer. Development batches have scoped maintainer acceptance; PNA guidance was accepted. Three-language romance display and unreported combinations retain their independent verification scope. Replace the entire old folder, keeping version folders and LoadFolders.xml. Removed old 1.7 launcher definitions have no save migration. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC; Ideology is required for culture and rituals. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable.
